assumptions: ws-hv -> ws_hv::score (ws_hv.rs:152-218): Cheraaqee 3-scale Haar H/V similarity + diagonal-weighted pooling, f64, OpenCV 15-bit gray ingress.
Ingress per px per img (ws_hv.rs:112-130): u32 mul3 + add2 + add16384 + shr15 + u8->f64 cvt + store = mul3 add3 load3 cvt1 store1.
haar() (ws_hv.rs:18-50) per out px: 4 edge-clamped loads, lo/hi row sums (4 add/sub + 4 mul c) + 4 band combos (4 add/sub + 4 mul c) + 4 stores = mul8 add8 load4 store4. Three chained levels on LL.

details() (ws_hv.rs:131-151): per img — L1 h/v kept as-is; L2 h/v and diag upsampled x2 cubic; L3 h/v upsampled x4 (two cubic x2) then bilinear-resized to L1 diag size. resize() (ws_hv.rs:59-108) per out px: 4x4 taps -> 16 fma-ish (mul+add inner, mul+add outer) = 20 mul + 16 add + 16 loads + 8 cvt (f32 coeff -> f64); weights precomputed per axis (negligible). Cubic out elems: 3x(4*L2) for L2 ups, 2x(4*L3 + 4*L2... actually up(3rd) x2 gives 4*L3 then 4*L2) + 2 bilinear resizes of 4*L3->L1.

Pool (ws_hv.rs:175-217): over min common size ~L1: per px 6 channels x (abs2 + 2uv (2mul) + u2+v2 (2mul) + 2 add + div + similarity-mul) = mul31? counted: per c mul5 add2 div1 abs2 -> mul30 add12 div6 abs12; weight = max(abs sa, abs sb): abs2 cmp1; column += sim*w (mul+add), weight_col += w (add); loads 14. Column loop order: numerator/denominator accumulate per column (outer x).
